versions.changelog:
artisan-expert-generator v1.0.0

- Initial release of the skill with a complete expert generator workflow.
- Supports automated six-dimensional information gathering, user knowledge integration, framework extraction, validation, and dual-Agent refinement.
- Enables streamlined creation of standardized professional expert Skills for a variety of occupational domains, including cross-disciplinary (T-shaped) expert generation.
- Provides step-by-step guides, user confirmation checkpoints, quality verification scripts, and support for private knowledge (PDF/Word/Markdown) integration.
- Includes example usage scenarios, industry/discipline expansion, and template/asset references for easy adoption.
